micPermission.label: Microphone permission
micPermission.hint: The browser asks once. If blocked, allow the microphone from the lock icon in the address bar.

micLevel.label: Microphone level
micLevel.hint: Speak to check that the bar moves.

micVolume.label: Microphone volume
micVolume.hint: How loud you sound to the other side.

speaker.label: Speaker
speaker.hint: The device that plays the other side's voice.
speaker.unsupportedHint: Your browser plays sound on the system default device.

speakerVolume.label: Speaker volume
speakerVolume.hint: How loud the other side sounds.

ringDevice.label: Ringtone device
ringDevice.hint: Where the ringtone plays, for example the computer speakers while you wear a headset.
ringDevice.unsupportedHint: Your browser plays sound on the system default device.

ringVolume.label: Ringtone volume
ringVolume.hint: Off keeps the call card without sound.

autoAnswer.label: Auto answer
autoAnswer.hint: Answers incoming calls automatically after a short delay.

dnd.label: Do not disturb
dnd.hint: Incoming calls get a busy signal while this is on.

notifications.label: Desktop notifications
notifications.hint: Shows a system notice for incoming calls when this tab is in the background. If your browser blocks it, allow notifications from the lock icon in the address bar.

notConfigured.title: Phone not set up
notConfigured.line: Ask your administrator to finish your extension.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.line: Use a current version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

micBlocked.title: Microphone blocked
micBlocked.line: Allow it from the lock icon in the address bar.

paused.title: Phone paused
paused.line: Your workspace has more phones than seats. Ask the workspace owner.

suspended.title: Phone suspended
suspended.line: Your workspace subscription is suspended. Ask an administrator to renew it.

scopeMismatch.title: Phone belongs to another workspace
scopeMismatch.line: This page is signed in to a different workspace session. Reload the page to continue.
